name: Shield
notes: HoH1 values. HoH2 has the same modifiers (Modifiers::BlockProjectile and Modifiers::Block). HoH1's block was a flat amount, so it likely wants a percentage at HoH2's damage numbers.
summary: Your shield blocks most projectiles coming at you from the front, in an arc that widens with each level, and has a 25% chance to block some Physical damage.
